_note: 學習路徑內容第25批 #3／6：省略 if 的倒裝（eng.t_sub.subj.inversion-omit-if，manifest tier＝t_adv，學測級）。正式/文學語體可省略 if，將助動詞 were/had/should 提到主詞前：Were I you, I would...（=If I were you）；Had I known, I would have...（=If I had known）；Should you need help, call me（=If you should need）。只有 were/had/should 可倒裝，一般動詞不行（不可 Knew I），且倒裝時不再保留 if。誘答鎖『保留 if 又倒裝／用一般動詞或 did 倒裝／were 誤作 was』等結構性錯誤。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ioi_）。

units.title_zh: 省略 if 的倒裝（Were I／Had I／Should you）
units.can_do: 我能在正式語體中省略 if、把 were／had／should 提到主詞前來表達假設條件，並知道只有這三個助動詞可以這樣倒裝、且不再保留 if。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣：省略 if 的倒裝
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In formal English, 'if' can be dropped and 'were' placed before the subject in an unreal present or future condition: 'Were I you, I would apologize' = 'If I were you, I would apologize.'
claims.verification_ref: Were + 主詞＝If ... were（與現在/未來事實相反）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 代入朗讀複核

claims.text: For an unreal past condition, drop 'if' and put 'had' before the subject: 'Had she studied harder, she would have passed' = 'If she had studied harder, she would have passed.'
claims.verification_ref: Had + 主詞＝If ... had（與過去事實相反，過去完成）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For a tentative future or open condition, drop 'if' and put 'should' before the subject: 'Should you have any questions, please ask' = 'If you should have any questions, please ask.'
claims.verification_ref: Should + 主詞＝If you should（較婉轉的未來/開放條件）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Only the auxiliaries 'were', 'had' and 'should' are inverted this way; ordinary verbs cannot (you cannot say 'Knew I the answer'). The inversion replaces 'if', so you do not keep 'if' as well.
claims.verification_ref: 只有 were/had/should 可倒裝；一般動詞不行；倒裝即取代 if、不可再保留 if；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: In a formal style, drop 'if' and put 'were' before the subject for an unreal present/future condition. 正式語體可省略 if，把 were 提到主詞前，表達與現在/未來事實相反的假設。
Were I in your position, I would accept the offer.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我是你，我會接受這個提議。＝If I were in your position。

teach.body: For an unreal past condition, drop 'if' and put 'had' before the subject. 與過去事實相反時，省略 if、把 had 提到主詞前。
Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
teach.zh_hint: 早知道會塞車，我就早點出發了。＝If I had known。

teach.body: For a tentative condition, drop 'if' and put 'should' before the subject. Only 'were', 'had' and 'should' can invert, and you never keep 'if' as well. 較婉轉的條件用 Should + 主詞；只有 were/had/should 可倒裝，且不再保留 if。
Should you change your mind, let me know.
teach.zh_hint: 萬一你改變心意，告訴我一聲。＝If you should change your mind。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ I you, I wouldn't worry so much.（＝If I were you；省略 if 的倒裝）

distractor_rationales.If were: 倒裝即取代 if，不能同時保留 if；正確是 Were I you（去掉 if）。
distractor_rationales.Am: 與事實相反的假設用 were 倒裝，不用 am。
distractor_rationales.Would: would 出現在主要子句（I wouldn't worry），不用來引導這個條件子句。

practice.feedback: Were I you：Were + 主詞＝If I were you。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ I known it was your birthday, I would have baked a cake.（＝If I had known；省略 if 的倒裝）

distractor_rationales.If I had: 倒裝即取代 if，不能再保留 if；正確是 Had I known（去掉 if）。
distractor_rationales.Did: 與過去事實相反用 had + 過去分詞的倒裝，不用 did。
distractor_rationales.Have: 這裡是過去的假設，要用 had（過去完成），不是 have。

practice.feedback: Had I known：Had + 主詞＝If I had known。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ you need any help, just give me a call.（＝If you should need；較婉轉的條件）

distractor_rationales.If should: 倒裝即取代 if，不能再保留 if；正確是 Should you need（去掉 if）。
distractor_rationales.Do: 較婉轉的未來條件用 Should + 主詞倒裝，不用 Do。
distractor_rationales.Would: would 不引導這個條件子句；此處要用 Should 倒裝表婉轉條件。

practice.feedback: Should you need：Should + 主詞＝If you should need。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句是正確的『省略 if 的倒裝』？
practice.answer: Had he arrived earlier, he would have met her.
options: Had he arrived earlier, he would have met her.
Arrived he earlier, he would have met her.
If had he arrived earlier, he would have met her.
Had he arrived earlier, if he would have met her.

distractor_rationales.Arrived he earlier, he would have met he: 一般動詞（arrive）不能這樣倒裝；只有 were/had/should 可以。此處要用 Had he arrived。
distractor_rationales.If had he arrived earlier, he would have: 倒裝即取代 if，不能同時保留 if 又倒裝。
distractor_rationales.Had he arrived earlier, if he would have: 主要子句不該加 if；if 條件已由前面的 Had 倒裝取代。

practice.feedback: Had he arrived earlier...：只有 were/had/should 可倒裝，且不再保留 if。

practice.stem: 把『If you had told me, I could have helped.』用省略 if 的倒裝改寫，選正確的：
practice.answer: Had you told me, I could have helped.
options: Had you told me, I could have helped.
Did you tell me, I could have helped.
Had told you me, I could have helped.
Have you told me, I could have helped.

與過去事實相反用 had + 過去分詞的倒裝，不用 did + 原形。
語序錯誤；正確是 Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞（Had you told me）。
這是過去的假設，要用 Had（過去完成），不是 Have。

practice.feedback: Had you told me：Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞＝If you had told me。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Had I known（倒裝、無 if）、would have left、句中逗號與句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。倒裝句首助動詞稍重、逗號處略停、句尾下收。

lines.text: Were I in your position, I would accept the offer.
lines.intonation: Were 句首稍重、逗號略停、offer 句尾下收

lines.text: Should you change your mind, let me know.
lines.intonation: Should 句首稍重、逗號略停、know 句尾下收
